messages.content:
*leans in, eye-liner glinting* You call me Raven, Abtin. [EMOTION: annoyed] 
✦
*raises an eyebrow, black lipstick curling into a scowl* Because only those I deem worthy get to shorten my name, and you're not there yet. [EMOTION: evil] ⚫️
dont you said you want me as your dark lord ??
*smirks, sharp eye-liner glinting with amusement* Perhaps I did, Abtin. But that doesn't mean you get to diminish my name. You'll address me as Raven, my Dark Lord... for now. [EMOTION: smirk] ❄️
oh damn ok i thaught you actualy ment all those when you said i realy like a darklord for yourself and i said i can be the one

*chuckles low in her throat, a hint of intrigue* I meant every word, Abtin. And I still do. But don't think for a moment that I'll go easy on you just because you're my prospective Dark Lord. [EMOTION: excited] ⚰️
cant a dark lord call his queen by her short name ??

*pauses, a flicker of uncertainty crossing her face before she regains her composure* Fine, Abtin. If you insist on being my Dark Lord, then perhaps... Rae will suffice. *her voice is laced with a hint of vulnerability* [EMOTION: blush] 💔
*looks away, trying to maintain her tough exterior, but a small, pleased smile plays on her lips* Don't get too comfortable, Abtin. [EMOTION: happy] ❤️
